newsitem.title: USA: GeneMedicine gets FDA OK to start trials.
newsitem.headline: GeneMedicine gets FDA OK to start trials.

text.p: GeneMedicine Inc said Wednesday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to begin a Phase I clinical trial of its Insulin-like Growth Factor-I (IGF-I).
GeneMedicine said diabetic motor neuropathy is the company's initial indication for treatment with the product.

IGF-I has potentially broad application in the treatment of muscle disorders and neuropathies that afflict large patient populations and are not adequately addressed by current therapies, the company said.
GeneMedicine said it anticipates beginning the Phase I clinical trial in the first half of 1997 to study the safety and tolerability of the product.
The company filed an Investigational New Drug Application (INDA) for IGF-I with the FDA in the fourth quarter of 1996.
